sentences.en: It doesn't matter whether she admits her guilt or not.
sentences.zh: 她是否承认有罪并不重要。

sentences.en: Dan's guilt could not be proved without the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 没有凶器的话，丹的犯罪行为就无法被证明。

sentences.en: The fingerprints on the knife attest to her guilt.
sentences.zh: 刀上的指纹证实了她的犯罪事实。
